event: The Supreme Court (MA), in cassation case 742/K/TUN/2026 filed by HM Subhan, reportedly granted the suit and declared invalid the SMA equivalency certificate (suket penyetaraan) that Vice President Gibran used as a 2024 candidacy requirement. (update of E0044)
key_numbers: Case 742/K/TUN/2026 · ruling read/notified via e-court Fri 30 Oct 2026 · plaintiff HM Subhan asked for the suket to be declared invalid and withdrawn from Kemendikdasmen's Dirjen Dikdasmen · MA spokesperson Yanto had not yet confirmed · full ruling text not yet published
sources: CNN Indonesia <https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20261030160932-12-1421524/tok-kasasi-ma-nyatakan-suket-penyetaraan-ijazah-sma-gibran-tidak-sah> ; Kompas <https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2026/10/30/22131471/minta-dimusnahkan-dan-dinyatakan-tidak-sah-ini-gugatan-suket-ijazah-gibran> ; detikNews (top of news.detik.com/berita) <https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8732405/timeline-putusan-terkait-ijazah-hingga-sk-penyetaraan-sma-wapres-gibran>

event: Parties and officials react to the MA ruling on Gibran's suket: PKB says it will base political steps on the MK and MA rulings; PDIP reportedly discusses a hak angket; Gerindra asks Kemendikdasmen and KPU to explain publicly and says the VP's status follows constitutional mechanisms; KPU says election stages are already complete; Mahfud MD says the suket's creation should be processed criminally.
key_numbers: PKB (Muhammad Khozin, Komisi II) in talks with other factions and the civil-society alliance AKSI (Ray Rangkuti) · Gerindra spokesperson Sugiat Santoso (Deputy Chair Komisi XIII) · reactions published 30-31 Oct 2026 · PKB has not chosen hak angket or pemakzulan · no Istana/Gibran response to the MA ruling found

event: Jakarta Tipikor Court holds the next hearing in the trial of former Deputy Minister Silmy Karim and seven officials, the day the defence is due to file its objection (eksepsi) to the indictment. (update of E0417)
key_numbers: Thu 5 Nov 2026, 10.00 · indictment: extortion Rp168.9 billion, gratification Rp33.8 billion · Silmy alleged to have received Rp1.2 billion · 7 defendants (Silmy plus seven officials per Suara Merdeka)
